writing_rules: Load this template before creating or structurally editing a target owner.
Do not add an unregistered field. A new field requires maintenance-time template/schema revision first.
Dynamic/open maps permit new IDs only; each value must still satisfy the wildcard value contract.
Indexes/caches are rebuilt from authority and never used to bless new authoritative fields.
Canonical key order is a writing convention only; semantic validation does not depend on JSON object order.
